title: Authorized Pharmacist defined for collaborative drug therapy management
rule_summary: Under 243 CMR 2.12(1), Authorized Pharmacist means a pharmacist who: (a) is currently registered by the Board of Registration in Pharmacy and is in good standing; (b) MEETS THE REQUIREMENTS OF 247 CMR 16.02: Pharmacist Qualifications; and (c) is participating in drug therapy management with a supervising physician pursuant to a written CDTM agreement with written protocols. The three limbs are stated together.
exam_relevance: Tests that the Board of Registration in Medicine's own regulation makes satisfaction of 247 CMR 16.02 part of the definition of an authorized pharmacist, so the Board of Pharmacy qualification standard governs even where a question is framed on 243 CMR 2.12.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Medicine regulations

common_confusions: Registration in good standing with the Board of Registration in Pharmacy is only the first limb of the definition; the pharmacist must also meet 247 CMR 16.02 and be participating under a written agreement with written protocols.
verification_notes: Read in the current official publication of 243 CMR 2.00 at the Board of Registration in Medicine download link on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule rather than by changing an existing record, so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
